root_cause: The canonical predictive Edge Function had no route to its already-approved Composio/Groq fallback and stopped when Anthropic rejected requests because the account had insufficient API credits. The pg_cron success signal did not measure provider acceptance or finished forecasts.
prevention: Use only the canonical pre-approved ACTIVE fallback model for the precise predictive use case
Distinguish transient primary-provider credit/rate/service exhaustion from nonrecoverable authorization or governance errors
Limit fallback to one bounded proxy call; never mark invalid provider output as success
Store actual model/provider and fallback provenance in existing canonical predictive-run health evidence
Reject unsupported forecast evidence or an unconfirmed success receipt
